name: BSCW Women's Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Carrying BSCW's own name into WWP's ring, the belt was gifted to Talia Wichzini as WWP launched, following her own run as a prior champion under BSCW's banner.

name: WWP World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside the Women's Heavyweight Title in WWP's own founding FAQ; no holder or defense survives in this collection's own record.
